title: Seeing tall white children in the Indian Springs barracks
summary: Charles Hall tells of Seeing tall white children in the Indian Springs barracks, about 1965-1967 at Indian Springs barracks, Nevada, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: time when I thought that it that I must be short on vitamins when they would come into my barracks at India in Springs and I would get up and I would see the children playing

plain: A man named Charles Hall, who says he spent three years in the 1960s among tall, pale beings he calls the Tall Whites while stationed at Indian Springs, a military site in the Nevada desert, says these beings would come into his barracks there. He says he would get up and see their children playing, and at first he thought he must be short on vitamins and imagining it. If true, it would mean such beings lived alongside US military staff.
